# Sverkaus Physical AI Data Lab

> Sverkaus connects industrial workflows with Physical AI. We are an operational and engineering integrator for specification-driven Physical AI data production—embedding calibrated multi-sensor capture (synchronized wrist + stereo RGB, 3D hand kinematics, UMI/exoskeletons, tactile/force/sEMG, optional LWIR thermal, and client BYO hardware) directly into active commercial and industrial workplaces in Ukraine (operating base), Germany, Poland, and on request. Every batch passes Site Security Clearance (GO/HOLD/NO GO) and on-site Edge QA (RELEASE/HOLD/REJECT), tracks Recorded/Submitted/Accepted hours separately, preserves natural failure/recovery trajectories, ships with SHA-256 provenance manifests and zero fabricated robot actions, and offers Site Partners paid participation plus an optional path to Automation Opportunity Assessment.

## Core Pages

- [Overview (For Robotics Teams & OEMs)](https://sverkaus.com/): Specification-driven physical data production, research-grounded ML transfer principles, unified Capture Stack (Track A/B/C), live workplace domains, 3-step pilot workflow, technical FAQ, and pilot scoping form.
- [Site Partners (For Businesses & Facilities)](https://sverkaus.com/partners): Paid, project-based workplace collaboration under NDA with zero shift disruption, Privacy by Design, EU AI Act/GDPR alignment, and optional Automation Opportunity Assessment.
- [Careers & Collaboration](https://sverkaus.com/careers): Project-based Capture & Data QA Specialist roles and Data Collection Site Partner opportunities.

## Technical Specifications & Guides

- [Capture Methodology & Edge QA](https://sverkaus.com/methodology): Peer-reviewed transfer principles (arXiv:2410.18647, arXiv:2512.22414, arXiv:2506.01944, arXiv:2505.21864), Track A/B/C hardware, Site Security Clearance (GO/HOLD/NO GO), Edge QA gates (RELEASE/HOLD/REJECT), Cost-per-Accepted-Hour accounting, and the 6-stage Eval Loop.
- [Robotics Data Vendors & Approaches Compared](https://sverkaus.com/compare): Objective 2026 comparison of Bulk Egocentric Catalogs, Enterprise Data Mega-Factories, Lab Teleoperation & Sim-Only Pipelines, and Sverkaus Embedded Live-Workplace Capture; 4 B2B engagement modes; 6-point vendor procurement audit checklist.
- [Manipulation Domains & Sensor Mapping](https://sverkaus.com/domains): Domain-to-sensor mapping for industrial laundries/deformables, electronics/wire-harness/precision repair workshops, commercial & dark kitchens (LWIR thermal/liquids), skilled construction & maintenance trades (drywall, tiling, plumbing/HVAC/electrical), and 3PL warehouses.
- [Dataset Formats, Provenance & World Models](https://sverkaus.com/formats): Export specifications for LeRobot, RLDS, MCAP / Rerun, HDF5 / Zarr, and Parquet + MP4; SHA-256 episode integrity; clean separation of human observations vs measured kinematic streams (zero fabricated robot actions); world-model subgoal conditioning.
- [Workplace Privacy by Design, EU AI Act & GDPR](https://sverkaus.com/privacy): 6-document legal clearance packet, Site Security Clearance (GO/HOLD/NO GO), offline capture (zero corporate IT network connection, zero audio by default), Scoped FOV framing, GDPR/DSGVO/RODO & EU AI Act provenance, international jurisdiction adaptation, and Industrial Data-to-Automation partnerships.

## Machine-Readable Reference Schemas (JSON)
